# Jest Mock Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > Jest

## Overview

Implements mocking strategies with Jest including module mocks, spy functions, and manual mocks for isolated unit testing

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [jest-mock-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
jest-mock-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@jest-mock-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Mock modules with jest.mock()
- Create spy functions with jest.spyOn()
- Build manual mocks in __mocks__ directory
- Implement mock factories for configurable mocks

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Jest Mocking**: Module and function mocking patterns
- **Manual Mocks**: __mocks__ directory conventions
- **Mock Functions**: jest.fn() and jest.spyOn() patterns
